items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: You see we had Fats Robin that played the straight trumpet.

ctx.x: Oh gosh, I can't think of his name.

Isn't that awful. What did Red play? Trumpet. You see we had Fats Robin that played the straight trumpet. Red Temple was. No, and Red played the second trumpet in the shows and on the band numbers and on the dance numbers where they, we had, we had to play for dancing couples or dancing singles. Why, Red played the first trumpet and he took off, jazzed it up and I mean he really, he really played. I know who you're talking about. Yeah, I know you do.
